description: This file contains SQL DDL statements for creating a table and indexes, as well as PL/SQL functions for writing, reading, and clearing grain state data in an Orleans storage system. It is specific to Oracle database and implements storage logic for Orleans grains, including hashing strategies and version control.

methods.name: WriteToStorage
methods.description: Function to insert or update grain state data in the Orleans storage table, handling concurrency and versioning.

methods.name: ClearStorage
methods.description: Function to nullify the payload of a grain state, effectively deleting it while updating the version.

methods.name: ReadFromStorage
methods.description: Query to retrieve the payload and version of a grain state from storage.
